- [FAIL] IQ (Quiescent Current per Amplifier): iq: measured 63.59 uA violates max 650 nA | conditions: IO = 0, VDD = 5.0V, VDD = +1.4V to +6.0V, VSS= GND, TA= +25°C, VCM = VDD/2, VOUT ≈VDD/2, VL = VDD/2 and RL = 1 MΩ to VL.
- [FAIL_TYP] GBWP (Gain Bandwidth Product): gbw: measured 2.431 MHz vs typ 9 kHz (±2.7 kHz band) | conditions: MCP6441/2/4, TA = +25°C, VDD = +1.4V to +6.0V, VSS = GND, VCM = VDD/2, VOUT ≈ VDD/2, VL = VDD/2, RL = 1 MΩ to VL and CL = 60 pF.
